subtitle: A stage, granted -- and a title in the other spelling
description: The calling is the college's word for 'you may begin', and completing
it grants the stage `my_pack:inducted` -- a stage reward, the write
half of the stage feature. What the word looks like on the card is
written in the other spelling a text field takes: a translation key
with an English fallback, `tasked.example.the_calling`, so a pack
translating this questline can, and a player with no lang entry
The worked KubeJS script in the manual grants the same stage from a
`questCompleted` listener watching for this quest's id -- the script
way and the reward way are two roads to the same flag, and a stage
gate is per player even inside a party.
